text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond crosses the finish line in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: What're you talking about, you're in great shape!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was a beautiful run!!
The way you run, Diamond-chan,
you just look straight ahead and stretch out...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It feels so untouched and uninfluenced by anything.
I really love that about it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, a natural outcome, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you stumble here,
you won't be worthy of being my opponent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is my running...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I was able to run without any discomfort!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If Trainer looked it over and saw no problem, then that's a relief!
choice_data_list: There was real power in your strides.
There was real power in your strides.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I wouldn't say she gained raw power,
I let her know that there were noticeable improvements in the force of her push-off and the stability of her core.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really...? I wasn't consciously thinking about it at all when running, though...
choice_data_list: It's become a natural part of your running.
It's become a natural part of your running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, by regaining her natural running style,
the results of all her past training naturally began to show.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! 
So it isn't impossible for me
to build up my power after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They said that the path to overseas races someday is also a possibility...
choice_data_list: Let's find a way that suits you
Let's find a way that suits you best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's possible that training could once again
affect her running.
However, with how she is now, there should be nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Now that she understands the essence of her own running, she should be able to find the right method for her growth."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm okay.
I won't hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: For the sake of my wish, I will run looking only ahead!
choice_data_list: Keep that momentum going for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Finally, a race against McQueen-san...!
And Kita-chan, too!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The stage I've always dreamed of is finally here...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides, by achieving victory,
I can also prove my strength as a "renowned Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The person I look up to and my longtime rival...What immense good fortune to compete with both of them—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am prepared to risk life and limb for this challenge!!
